name: LOD Generation for 3DGS
definition: A method to reduce the number of Gaussians copied, stored, sorted, and rendered by merging Gaussians into clusters based on similar attributes, minimizing distant appearance impact without altering scene creation.
summary: LOD Generation for 3DGS reduces Gaussian count by clustering and arithmetic averaging within a page-based virtual memory system, distinct from moment-matching or hierarchical merging methods.
